name: Lunenburg
tagline: Colourful UNESCO fishing town on Nova Scotia's coast
summary: Lunenburg is a brightly painted harbour town and UNESCO World Heritage Site, one of the best-kept British colonial towns in North America. Walk its steep grid of red, yellow and blue houses, visit the Fisheries Museum and the Bluenose II schooner, sail the bay, eat lobster and drive the coast to Peggy's Cove lighthouse.
seasonNote: Summer and early autumn; many places close in winter.
arrival: About 1 hour 15 minutes by car from Halifax.
gettingAround: Walk the town; a car for the coast.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 15 to 20 percent.
foodTip: Lobster rolls, fish chowder, scallops and Lunenburg pudding.
buyTip: Local crafts and Ironworks distillery spirits.
